query:
SELECT empresaSlug, dia, mes, ano, cat1, cat2, cat3, cat4, cat5, cat6, cat7, cat8, cat9, totalGeral
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-seraphine' AND mes = 5 AND ano = 2026 AND dia >= 14
ORDER BY dia;
